items.title: Crown Castle (CCI) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Cut As Analysts Weigh Tower Headwinds
items.summary: Crown Castle’s fair value estimate has been revised from US$99.07 to US$96.12 per share, signaling a slightly more cautious view on the stock’s price potential in current models. This adjustment aligns with mixed analyst commentary, where optimism around tower fundamentals and cost cuts is balanced against concerns about EchoStar and DISH related rent loss, slower carrier leasing, and higher funding costs.
